text: Figure 8.1: Example of a Sender-Receiver Interface “ECUMCurrentMode” with a single ModeDeclarationGroup The ModeDeclarationGroup is a set of ModeDeclarations. Within the definition of the group, one ModeDeclaration describes the initial mode that is assumed at startup. For example, for the case of the ECU power state, the ModeDeclarationGroup “ECUMMode” could d efine the group of modes named { STARTUP_SHUTDOWN, RUN, POST_RUN, SLEEP, WAKE_SLEEP }, with STARTUP_SHUTDOWN as the initial mode. The modes are mutually exclusive: at run -time, there is always one active mode in a ModeDeclarationGroup. The initial mode of a ModeDeclarationGroup is active before any mode switches occurred. << ModeSwitchInterface >> EcuMCurrentMode ModeDeclarationGroups : ECUMMode currentMode
